stories.title: U.S. launches second day of Iran strikes. And, World Cup facts to know before kickoff
stories.description: The U.S. launched air strikes on Iran for a second consecutive day. And, the World Cup kicks off today in Mexico City, where tensions threaten to disrupt events.

stories.title: Trump vows to hit Iran 'very hard tonight' and later take over its oil and gas sectors
stories.description: The latest threat comes after a second day of intensified strikes between the U.S and Iran, pushing the Middle East closer to the resumption of a full-scale war.

stories.description: Iran says it responded to US strikes by targeting American assets in Kuwait, Jordan and Bahrain, which reported damage to its capital city overnight.

stories.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 17, reports say
stories.description: Nine of them were killed in a series of attacks in the town of Tayr Debba, according to Lebanon's state news agency.

stories.title: US strikes Iran in response to downing of military helicopter
stories.description: President Donald Trump earlier accused Iran of shooting down the US helicopter over the Strait of Hormuz and vowed to respond.

stories.title: Sea drone rescues US army helicopter crew near Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: The uncrewed vessel - which looks similar to a speedboat - rescued the two soldiers from an Apache helicopter that went down on Monday.

stories.title: Trump tells BBC Netanyahu did not defy him

stories.title: Iran and Israel say they will pause strikes but warn of retaliation if ceasefire breached again

stories.description: Israel says the attacks on the Lebanese capital were ordered "in response to Hezbollah's firing at Israeli territory".
